title: AGICL Ledger (ACL-1.0)
description: Machine-readable representation of a ledger produced under ACL-1.0 (AGI Component Ledger). This schema is a faithful encoding of the published ACL-1.0 protocol: eight components, four classification states, four evidence tiers. It introduces no methodology beyond ACL-1.0. Filename uses the AGICL technical namespace; the published protocol name remains 'ACL-1.0'. See ACL-1.0.md.

protocol.description: The instrument and version this ledger was produced under. Fixed for this schema.

system.description: The exact object under audit. A ledger is invalid if the object shifts between components (ACL-1.0 §6.1).

audit_date.description: Date the audit was completed (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

auditor.description: Name or organization performing the audit.

components.description: The eight components of ACL-1.0. Each must carry a state and a tier (ACL-1.0 §5).

boundary_cases.description: Any component whose classification was contested during audit, with its reasoning (ACL-1.0 §6.7, §7). May be empty.

access_limits.description: Components the auditor could not test, stated plainly (ACL-1.0 §6.5, §8). A ledger presented without access limits is incomplete; for a fully open system this array may be empty, and that itself is the statement.

tier.description: ACL-1.0 §5 evidence tier. A: independent reproduction, disinterested. B: developer disclosure with reproducible method. C: developer disclosure without reproducible method. D: marketing/demonstration/statement.

basis.description: One-line basis for the finding (ACL-1.0 §8 report format).

allOf.$comment: ACL-1.0 §4/§5: Tier C and D evidence cannot support Constructed. A state's tier is capped by the best available evidence; Constructed requires Tier A or B.
